title: Retain recent backups frequently and historical backups weekly
description: Implemented and applied 2026-09-24: seven-day Aurora PITR, 12-hour snapshots retained seven days, and Sunday snapshots retained 90 days from creation. Existing recovery points keep their current expiration dates. The reviewed saved plan changed only the development backup plan; live rules and a fresh no-change plan verified the rollout. Observe future scheduled jobs separately; see docs/DEPLOYMENT-2026-09-24.md.
rationale: Reduce modeled older snapshot storage from $34.86 to about $2.52 per month at a constant 10 GB database without changing recent recovery granularity.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly two snapshot rules: 12-hour/seven-day and weekly/90-day; native PITR remains seven days.
No recovery point, vault, database, key or unrelated resource is deleted or replaced.
Live plan configuration and a subsequent no-change plan verify the applied policy; scheduled job success is a later operational check.
rollback_notes: Restore the previous 12-hour/90-day rule through a new reviewed plan; this affects future snapshots only and cannot extend or recover already expired snapshots.

title: Adopt standard CloudFront and WAF without weakening private origins
description: Replace the abandoned Free subscription requirement with standard pay-as-you-go edge billing. The owner explicitly authorized deleting the failed empty quartermaster-dev-edge-free stack from AWS and Terraform, superseding the retention proposal. Clean up only that verified empty stack through a reviewed saved plan and remove the obsolete state-forget bypass. Verify the exact distribution/WAF and absence of subscription associations at release time. GitHub connection was verified AVAILABLE on 2026-09-24; see the deployment record for cleanup evidence.
rationale: Accept the $6 fixed WAF baseline and usage billing while removing Free-plan eligibility as a release dependency.
acceptance_criteria: No Free subscription is created or required. Only the explicitly authorized failed empty stack is deleted; no application or data resource is destroyed.
Release-role read permissions remain scoped where supported, with no subscription mutation permission.
WAF rate limiting, AWS_IAM Lambda URLs and signed OAC remain intact.
Do not claim public release until exact-commit pipeline deployment, HTTPS smoke and unsigned-origin denial checks pass.
rollback_notes: Keep the distribution unpublished if validation fails. Preserve deployment evidence and state versions; do not recreate the deleted failed stack or restore stale state as rollback. Any return to a subscription requires separate approval and validation.

title: Codify accepted operating and deployment constraints
description: Apply accepted operating/infrastructure decisions: Erick operates the one-church SaaS pilot, privacy and human physical-work responsibility remain first-class, Ohio is primary, three US regions are approved, default-profile credentials select development, uptime is 99.5% with a 60-second cold start, recovery prefers at most one day of data loss with seven days tolerated, and the public repo uses CodeBuild and CodePipeline. Decision 0007 closes Q-013: one online-only mobile/desktop web client, no durable offline queue or native release prerequisite. Restore service within 24 hours; create a separate production account only after church acceptance while retaining development in the existing account.
rationale: The foundational direction is settled. Configuration and implementation gates must enforce it without confusing development credentials with production authorization or data-loss tolerance with recovery time.
acceptance_criteria: Dated decision history is retained; decision 0007 closes Q-013 and supersedes native build/framework/local-storage assumptions in Q-009/Q-025 without changing the public-repository/cloud-CI decisions.

The AI scope reflects human responsibility for physical work, advisory reminders, optional measurements, immediate skip handling, and church-configured restrictions without platform certification of worker qualifications.

Configuration defaults to us-east-2, enforces approved processing destinations us-east-2/us-east-1/us-west-2, and records 99.5% uptime, the 60-second cold allowance, accepted 24-hour RTO, preferred 24-hour RPO, and tolerated 168-hour RPO.
rollback_notes: Decision records are append-only; supersede a decision with a new dated record and keep affected features disabled until re-reviewed.

title: Scaffold the typed monorepo and validation gates
description: Create the pnpm TypeScript workspace, application/service/package directories from DESIGN.md, deterministic lint/type/test/build scripts, lockfiles, secret scanning, dependency scanning, and minimal contributor documentation. First milestone includes tested retention/deletion-metadata policy, synthetic estate UI, health-only Lambda entry point, database isolation schema, and validated development Terraform; application authentication/CRUD and cloud deployment remain separate completion gates.
rationale: Shared contracts and repeatable checks prevent divergent mobile/web/API schemas and make all later infrastructure and cost controls enforceable in CI.
acceptance_criteria: A clean checkout installs reproducibly and all lint, type, unit, and build commands pass.
Runtime schemas in packages/contracts generate clients without uncommitted output.
No secret or high-severity dependency finding is present.
rollback_notes: Revert the scaffold commit as one unit before application data or cloud resources depend on its package names.

title: Implement account bootstrap and Terraform cost guardrails
description: Bootstrap development in the account reached by local profile default in us-east-2. The initial data/governance deployment is authorized; follow the saved-plan gates and current evidence in docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md and RUNBOOK_ROLLOUT.md. Preserve the private operator-supplied alert recipient and resized-photo retention until photo/asset/tenant deletion. Parameterize a distinct future production account and gate its bootstrap on church acceptance, retaining development in the existing account. Create separate environment backends/roles, enforce project tags and account guards, protect state, configure budgets/anomaly alerts, and reject prohibited always-on/public resources or Aurora auto-pause inhibitors. CI/CD roles, anomaly monitoring, and production remain separate work; do not mark the full task complete after the foundation deployment.
rationale: This establishes isolation and prevents NAT gateways, load balancers, public databases, OpenSearch, RDS Proxy, logical replication, Global Database, zero-ETL, Babelfish, provisioned AI/compute/Aurora, or any nonzero database minimum from silently raising the cost floor.
acceptance_criteria: Development targets the STS-verified default-profile account in us-east-2. Production account bootstrap is gated on church acceptance, production account guards reject the development account ID, and environments use distinct state, roles, and resources. No production account is needed to validate or deploy development.
All supported resources carry Application=Quartermaster, Environment, Owner=ErickBrown, CostCenter, DataClass, and ManagedBy=Terraform tags; untaggable resources have an inventory mapping.
Account IDs, regions, names, role ARNs, DNS, keys, and integration references are parameterized; changing account configuration cannot silently replace or delete the source stack.
A fixture containing each prohibited resource fails policy tests and the intended target plan passes.
Every Aurora instance has minimum 0 ACU and a 300-second auto-pause. Decision 0006 selects standard CloudFront/WAF for development; production remains a later account/bootstrap step.
Read-only checks verify standard development edge billing, its exact WAF and OAC-protected origins. No flat-rate subscription or eligibility gate is required.

No cloud apply occurs as part of validation. An explicitly authorized deployment applies only the separately reviewed saved plan, verifies live controls and drift, and records the exact deployed subset.

Resized photos have no age-based expiry; photo, asset, or tenant deletion ends their retention. The 15-day original rule never targets resized/ objects. Backup-purge and version-aware cleanup remain release gates.

The initial backup role has no general-purpose AWS-managed backup policy, SSM/EC2 permissions, restoration, or cross-region copy permissions. A completed on-demand backup proves the narrowed role can protect the exact development cluster.
rollback_notes: Do not delete state buckets or accounts. Revert IAM/policy changes through a reviewed Terraform plan, preserving state versions and access logs.

title: Build private CloudFront and serverless API ingress
description: Current authorized development increment implements infra/environments/delivery: private S3 preview hosting, AWS_IAM health-only Lambda URL with OAC, ACM/DNS and standard pay-as-you-go WAF/CloudFront per decision 0006. Publish after protected-origin/billing checks and deploy the exact dev commit through CodePipeline. COST-013 tracks the explicitly authorized failed Free stack deletion. Authenticated core/conversation APIs and production remain later increments; do not mark those complete from a health-only release.
rationale: This provides secure ingress without API Gateway, ALB, public origin bypass, VPC compute, or provisioned concurrency while keeping static and API traffic same-origin.
acceptance_criteria: Direct S3 and Lambda Function URL requests are denied while equivalent CloudFront requests succeed.
Viewer auth headers, request bodies, query strings, and correlation IDs reach the intended API without being cached.
No NAT gateway, load balancer, public IPv4 address, or provisioned Lambda concurrency appears in the plan.
AI throttling cannot exhaust the core API reserved concurrency allocation.
rollback_notes: Roll CloudFront behavior/origin changes back to the previous version. Never make a Lambda Function URL public as a rollback; use a reviewed HTTP API fallback if OAC fails.

title: Implement Aurora Data API and tenant-safe domain core
description: Provision supported Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 clusters with minimum 0 ACU and five-minute auto-pause, Data API and one secret per environment; implement migrations, forced RLS, capability checks, assets/locations/media metadata/audit/outbox, pre-commit delayed SQS outbox triggers, idempotency, optimistic concurrency, bounded query adapters, and the cold-activation contract.
rationale: This supplies the relational estate and transaction guarantees while avoiding VPC Lambda networking, NAT, RDS Proxy, and unbounded connection fanout.
acceptance_criteria: Dev and production Aurora are configured with minimum 0 ACU and each reaches zero after five idle minutes in a deployed integration test.
The pinned Aurora PostgreSQL version is offered in the selected region and explicitly supports Serverless v2 auto-pause to 0 ACUs; no provider default can select a different version.
Ordinary and 24-hour-deep-sleep activation tests show visible progress, finish within the approved 60-second envelope, make at most three attempts, and cannot duplicate a retried mutation.
No RDS Proxy, provisioned instance, logical replication, Global Database, zero-ETL integration, Babelfish, synthetic keepalive, or required pg_cron job is present.
A non-owner application database role cannot read or mutate another tenant even when repository predicates are intentionally omitted.
At least two synthetic tenants exercise isolation during the one-church pilot, and adding a real church requires no deployment, hard-coded tenant ID, or per-tenant database.

Air conditioners and appliances use versioned class schemas/templates; a new class that uses existing field and capture capabilities can be added without changing the core asset table or rewriting existing records.
Every create/final commit is idempotent and every update rejects a stale record version.
API/query pagination stays within Data API row/result limits and no Lambda is VPC-attached.
A successful domain transaction and its outbox event commit atomically, every committed outbox batch has a previously accepted durable delayed trigger, and no outbox worker polls an idle database.
rollback_notes: Use expand/contract migrations. Roll application code back only while the previous schema remains compatible; never destroy a cluster or state. Restore data only through the tested recovery procedure.

title: Deliver the online-only mobile capture and desktop register
description: Implement Cognito PKCE server-side web sessions, role-aware estate/register/detail views, church data-administration controls, scoped temporary support access, configurable service/privacy/support identity initially naming Erick Brown, and foreground mobile structured capture in apps/web. Add server-saved drafts, honest acknowledgment-based save state, bounded foreground retry, stale-version conflict resolution, photo capture/upload and touch/keyboard fallbacks. No native app, persistent local asset cache, offline queue or background synchronization.
rationale: One non-AI phone-to-desktop asset/photo workflow validates the domain, permissions and mobile browser capture before generative automation creates records, without committing to offline synchronization complexity.
acceptance_criteria: A user signs in on a phone, creates an asset with a photo, receives a server acknowledgment, and finds/edits the same record on desktop.

Network/service loss pauses capture visibly; unsent input is not labeled saved or persisted as an offline queue. Foreground retry after an uncertain response produces no duplicate asset/media, and server-saved drafts can be resumed online. Unsent input need not survive reload/process death.
Stale record versions are rejected; the user can compare current server values and resolve conflicting edits without silent overwrite.

Actual iPhone Safari and Android Chrome pass camera/microphone permission, photo readability, upload interruption, screen-lock/tab-switching and session-expiry tests; viewport emulation alone is insufficient.
All primary capture actions work without speech or AI and pass accessibility checks.
Church administrators can manage memberships, permissions, records, exports, lifecycle requests, and scoped support grants; Erick's support sessions are expiring and audited.
Privacy acceptance covers purpose, recipients, access, and retention/deletion for enabled features; operator identity can later change without rewriting tenant IDs or prior audit actors.
Mobile and desktop use opaque Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite web sessions with CSRF controls; bearer tokens and tenant content are not persisted in browser application storage/caches.
rollback_notes: Keep API contracts compatible with supported previous web releases/open tabs. Disable features with server capability flags without deleting acknowledged server drafts; warn before refreshing unsaved in-memory input.

title: Implement the bounded media inference pipeline
description: Create private S3 media storage, constrained pre-signed uploads, quarantine validation, deterministic image variants, SQS/DLQ processing, multimodal observations with provenance/confidence, bounded concurrency/retries, and user confirmation promotion.
rationale: Queued idempotent processing isolates expensive/untrusted media and makes image inference optional without blocking core asset capture.
acceptance_criteria: Unexpected/active/oversized/decompression-bomb inputs are rejected without model invocation.
Duplicate S3/queue delivery produces one observation/variant set and no duplicate billable retry after success.
Serial, model, and other critical image values remain proposals until confirmed.
Poison messages reach the DLQ after the bounded attempt count and alarm without blocking other tenants.
The evaluation set meets approved per-field/capture-kind thresholds and records cost/latency.
rollback_notes: Disable the model/worker event mapping and retain originals/drafts. Revert to manual classification; never delete evidence or confirmed values during rollback.

title: Implement the safe voice conversation controller
description: Add short-lived Transcribe stream grants, foreground browser microphone capture, DynamoDB TTL session state, versioned deterministic workflows, typed AI tools, schema and policy validation, browser speech synthesis with device/privacy validation, final review/transactional commit, and AI usage/circuit-breaker controls. Stop capture on connection loss; no deferred offline audio.
rationale: This supplies the core voice-first UX while preventing autonomous mutation, unsafe prompts, quadratic context, and unbounded speech/model spend.
acceptance_criteria: Only allowlisted, schema-valid tools can change a draft and all consequential fields/actions follow confirmation policy.

Humans decide whether and how to perform physical work; AI offers optional capture prompts and advisory reminders, never certifies a person or site as safe, and accepts refusal/inaccessibility without repeated pressure.

Human-provided readings can be recorded without platform verification of trade qualifications; church-configured restrictions are enforced and generated instructions for hazardous physical work remain outside scope.
Each admitted stream/turn/session has a tested maximum duration/token/image/attempt cost and tenant/global circuit breaker.
The air-conditioner workflow creates the expected asset, two media links, reading, maintenance item, and access constraint exactly once.

When the core service remains reachable, AI outage falls back to manual entry and preserves server-saved drafts/media. Connection loss visibly pauses capture without implying unsent browser input is durable.
rollback_notes: Version and retain workflows/prompts. Disable AI admission and route sessions to manual controls; do not reinterpret or delete prior observations.

title: Implement bounded search reporting and rules
description: Add tenant-first PostgreSQL full-text/trigram/facet indexes, allowlisted query AST/compiler, async report/export jobs, declarative rule dry-run/execution, mutation caps, one-time schedules for actual future work, and non-polling outbox consumers.
rationale: The web comprehension workload can launch without an always-on search cluster or warehouse while retaining safe natural-language query translation.
acceptance_criteria: No user or model can submit raw SQL and every query is tenant/capability scoped, parameterized, row/time limited, and explain-plan tested.
Large reports become snapshot jobs and cannot monopolize interactive concurrency.
Rules show an affected-count/sample dry-run, are idempotent, and stop at the configured mutation cap.
No periodic empty database scan or outbox poll prevents Aurora from auto-pausing; scheduled invocations correspond to actual due or explicitly enabled periodic work.
Representative launch-scale searches/reports meet the approved warm latency objective without OpenSearch.
rollback_notes: Disable the affected rule/query feature and retain prior index/schema compatibility. Do not drop indexes or rule-run history until the previous version is stable.

title: Create supported CI CD and recovery operations
description: Current authorized increment implements disposable CodeBuild GitHub Actions checks, separate verify/build/deploy IAM roles, and a dev-only CodePipeline V2 release from the public repository. Packages checksummed build outputs, tests a published Lambda version before alias promotion, and preserves previous website versions for rollback. CodeConnections was AVAILABLE on September 24; recheck before deployment and never upload a personal GitHub token. Publish the reviewed standard-edge source before enabling automatic releases. Cloud configuration remains reviewed saved-plan Terraform, separate from automatic least-privilege application releases. Production/main deployment, expand-contract schema deployment, regional recovery and timed restore drills remain unfinished. Native SSH coordinator/signing is deferred under decision 0007, not a release gate.
rationale: Supported service roles, immutable promotion, and tested rollback/recovery are required to deploy the cost-optimized architecture safely.
acceptance_criteria: Public pull-request jobs run on disposable CodeBuild Linux runners with restricted IAM, no deployment/signing secrets, and no path to the LAN; untrusted workflows cannot dispatch mobile jobs.

The dev branch deploys only dev in the existing account and main only production in the separate production account through distinct roles/state/resources. Production deployment remains disabled until church acceptance and production bootstrap are complete.

One immutable web artifact serves desktop and mobile with matching commit provenance; no native signing/store account, local SSH coordinator or offline synchronization capability is required for release.
Production apply consumes the reviewed saved plan and cannot silently re-plan.

A restore drill validates row counts, tenant isolation, referenced original media versions/checksums, idempotent recovery, and sign-in against the preferred 24-hour RPO; backup age beyond 24 hours alerts and the seven-day tolerated ceiling is never mistaken for normal cadence.

The measured backup/copy/restore cost is recorded; a timed restore drill demonstrates the accepted 24-hour RTO including detection/operator response and core-service validation. Production bootstrap evidence records church acceptance and a production account ID distinct from development.

Account migration is documented and tested as target provisioning, data/identity/artifact migration, validation, and cutover with source preservation; no state rewrite is treated as a resource transfer.
No deployment is claimed until post-deploy smoke, metrics, and cost-dimension checks pass.
rollback_notes: Roll back immutable application artifacts and compatible configuration; roll database schema forward with a corrective migration. Preserve failed plans/logs and follow RUNBOOK_ROLLOUT.md rather than destroying state.

title: Tune active capacity edge plan and data tiers from evidence
description: After pilot telemetry, keep Aurora minimum capacity at zero while tuning maximum capacity and the auto-pause timeout, evaluate an optional co-pausing reader, define CloudFront paid-plan thresholds, tune media lifecycle and Aurora storage mode, and decide whether PostgreSQL search/reporting needs a projection service.
rationale: These are material active-cost/SLO migrations whose economics cannot be resolved from a greenfield estimate; none should silently reintroduce an idle compute floor.
acceptance_criteria: At least 90 days of cost, access, query, resume, and failure telemetry supports each selected change.
Updated formulas identify fixed/marginal delta and break-even for every option.
The approved plan meets SLO, RPO/RTO, security, and retention requirements without unexpected replacement/deletion.
Every selected database topology still reaches 0 ACU when idle unless an explicit product architecture decision supersedes the scale-to-zero requirement.
A rollback or restore procedure is tested before production apply.
rollback_notes: Apply one tuning change at a time. Return to the prior Terraform setting/storage class only after verifying minimum-duration/retrieval constraints and data availability.
